comment: A joined fighter alone on a Sabotage server carries the charge to A Frame, plants it and watches it detonate. Run with FRAGR_QA_MODE=sabotage FRAGR_QA_MAP=4 FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0 FRAGR_QA_SEED=42.

states.name: sabotage_joined
states.note: Joined on a Sabotage server: the first-person view with the one HUD line. A late joiner waits for the next round.

states.name: sabotage_muster
states.note: Muster in the attacker yard: the pistol from the spawn pad, the carried charge beside the weapon and the muster clock.

states.name: sabotage_at_site
states.note: Through Mid Doors to A Frame: the site plate, the correction frame and the plant ring.

states.name: sabotage_use_prompt
states.note: The carrier stands in A's plant area: the line's clock gives way to the hold-Use prompt.

states.name: sabotage_planting
states.note: Holding Use inside the ring: the plant bar fills under the crosshair.

states.name: sabotage_planted
states.note: Planted: the charge's timer replaces the round clock at the top of the screen.

states.name: sabotage_planted_world
states.note: The planted charge on the floor of A Frame, its light blinking with the beeps.

states.name: sabotage_detonated
states.note: Detonation: the burst at A Frame and the round card for the free coalition.
